violated_contract: A capped read that walks backwards from a range's end (most recent first) may only serve a range that has already ended. get_calendar_events_tool walked every range over 30 days back from its end in 30-day windows and stopped at max_results, so 'what's on my calendar for the next two months' returned events 30 to 60 days out and skipped the next 30 days.
canonical_prevention: Choose the read direction from where the range sits relative to now: walk back from the end only when the range has ended, and read a range that reaches into the future chronologically from its start. A hermetic test with a fake provider covers both directions.
